batch_node.name: git-serious double-tap home v0.5.0
batch_node.description: v0.5.0 of the double-tap home: /double-tap is Top Movers and, under it, the nightlies board (req-git-serious-double-tap-page-nightlies: one card per repository that runs on a schedule, each scheduled workflow's latest run, red when it failed and not observed when nothing ran in the window — where a red nightly is read, tap#137/#440). v0.4.0 (git-serious-double-tap#42) renamed the landing to Top Movers and gave the strip a time window from the page's query string (?window=all|7d|24h; selector upper-right; default 24h; an unknown value falls back and says so); All = a card per repository with an open pull request, no time filter. v0.3.0 made the strip the landing alone — the plugin's own card panel (req-git-serious-double-tap-page-strip): the repositories that moved, their open PRs and the check results on each PR's current head, the collection's freshness, and four links. The status wall and its not-observed companion (git_serious panels, mounted by USES_PANEL edge) live on /double-tap/status-wall. The gates panel left the landing; the gate view is one of the four links. git_serious must be seeded before this bundle (boot-profile population order). Node ids unchanged; upserts.

node.name: Top Movers
node.description: unified-systems-com through git-serious: the page the organization that builds TAP lives in to run its own CI/CD. v0.5.0, minimal by design: Top Movers — which repositories moved in the selected window, their open PRs, which checks pass or fail on each PR's current head, whether the collection is fresh, and links to the organization, machinery, gate and status-wall views (req-git-serious-double-tap-page-strip) — and under it the nightlies board: one card per repository that runs on a schedule, each scheduled workflow's latest run, red when it failed and not observed when nothing ran in the window (req-git-serious-double-tap-page-nightlies). The status wall lives on /double-tap/status-wall.

node.name: Top Movers
node.description: One card per repository that had a pull request opened, pushed, merged or building in the last 24 hours, ordered by the organization's criticality property then by most recent movement. Each open PR is one line: passed-check count, failed-check names, pending-check names — evaluated against the PR's current head, reruns deduplicated. Says when the collection last succeeded and when it is stale or failed. Links: repository → repository view, PR → GitHub, results → the check. Built as double-tap code first (req-git-serious-double-tap-page-strip); the repeatable card mechanism graduates to tap_web later.

node.name: Nightlies
node.description: One card per repository that runs on a schedule; one row per scheduled workflow with its LATEST scheduled run — red when it failed, running, other (with the word), green — and NOT OBSERVED when no scheduled run was collected in the window (26 hours by default), never green by default. Where a red nightly is read (tap#137: the fuzz campaign reds its run; tap#440: the not-observed state). Cards worst-first. Links: repository → repository view, workflow → its latest run on GitHub. Built as double-tap code beside the strip (req-git-serious-double-tap-page-nightlies); the second card panel, and so the graduation trigger for the card mechanism into tap_web.

node.name: double-tap status wall
node.description: The drill-down behind the demo strip: git-serious's status wall (every workflow's latest run across every repository) and the workflows the collected window could not say anything about. Both are git_serious panels mounted by USES_PANEL edge; this page only arranges them (req-git-serious-double-tap-page-home).
